title: kbmon --events gives two different items in two coord stores different trace and span ids for their kb.item spans
goal: the trace id and the span id of a kb.item span in kbmon --events hash the item id and the run's first move, so two items whose first moves have the same sequence number, in one store or two, never share a trace or a span id

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
def plant(status):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = status; d['sprint'] = sp
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted ' + status)
def walk(*states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
import tempfile as tf
iid2 = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Second', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
S2 = os.path.join(tf.mkdtemp(), 'c2.sqlite')
plant('doing')
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == iid2: d['status'] = 'doing'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted second')
def c2(store, *a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', store, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'landing', 'landed'):
    c2(S, 'transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s)
    c2(S2, 'transition', 'run/' + iid2, '--to', s)
def item_span(store, i):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--events', '--root', T, '--store', store], capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(env, KB_COORD_STORE=store))
    try:
        return [s for s in json.loads(r.stdout)['spans'] if s['name'] == 'kb.item' and s['attributes'].get('item') == i][0]
    except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError):
        return {}
a, b = item_span(S, iid), item_span(S2, iid2)
ok = bool(a) and bool(b) and a['trace'] != b['trace'] and a['id'] != b['id']
print('trace ids', a.get('trace'), b.get('trace'), '| span ids', a.get('id'), b.get('id'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
